title: AI references are not one perspective: people drawn 1.2-1.9x, tops too steep
summary: AI images draw people 1.2-1.9x the structure, tops too steep, furniture that can't fit. Weight the subject 2x, priors elsewhere, then fit each object's scale/position to its own pixels.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: dig: figures scaled 1.45-1.5 to their measured pixel heights; tunnel: standing man .5 m deeper and 1.07x so size AND reach land

doc.avoid: One global scale for people and architecture; free per-figure head positions as landmarks (a lean absorbs any height).
gotchas: Pin figure landmarks to one 3D point, or fit figure scale after the structure.
Record per-object corrections as data in the scene (POSE.*.s, notes).

problem.symptom: The solve wants absurd sizes (a 58-68 m deep top, a 2.4 m wall over a 3 m tunnel, a 9.7 m cell for a 1.8 m man); figures read 20-45% too small.
problem.cause: The image is not one perspective; people and the subject are drawn bigger than the structure.
problem.fix: Weight the subject region 2x, low weight + soft priors elsewhere; fit per-figure scale to its pixel height and position to its reach.
problem.detect: Residuals concentrate on people/tops; figure heights don't match.
